title: Cool and steady: no per-frame garbage, paced frames
description: Heavy settings (640x480 dither) made the phone lag and run hot: every frame allocated megabytes and the effects ran flat out on every core. Frames now reuse their buffers, and a pacer caps the frame rate and the share of time spent processing, lowering both when the phone reports heat.

clauses.text: Once running, a 640x480 dither-plus-VHS frame reuses the same picture buffers frame after frame instead of allocating new ones, while the previous frame's picture stays intact until the next one is done.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "steady frames reuse their buffers" passes

clauses.text: The frame pacer never runs faster than its frame-rate cap, keeps processing to at most its share of the time (so cores get to rest), and lowers the cap when the phone says it is getting hot.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "pacer caps rate and busy time and backs off when hot" passes

cases.description: frames N and N+2 return the same array object (double-buffered), frame N+1 a different one, and frame N's pixels are unchanged after frame N+1
simulated 60 fps camera: cheap frames are capped at 30 fps; 40 ms frames are spaced so busy share <= 60%; thermal 'moderate' halves the cap; 'severe' quarters it
